source_concerns.issue: 「Blink:」 printed in regular weight; every other On/Blink/Off lead-in is bold
「On:  Bluetooth Connected.」 double space and capital C (Wi-Fi row: 「connected」)

source_concerns.issue: car input 「11-16V⎓8A Max, Double to 8A Max」 (spec.in.r2.v2 「11V-16V⎓8A Max, Double to 8A Max」): the doubled value equals the single value, and the two places format the range differently
「2400W Rated per port, 2400W in Total」 for 4 × AC Output
space before the closing bracket 「45°C )」 in both temperature lines; double space after 「Discharging temperature:」
「Contact Jackery Customer Support」 has no full stop (FE row has one)
「4.3 To reset Wi-Fi & Bluetooth：」 the colon is a full-width CJK colon (U+FF1A, AdobeSongStd-Light in the text layer); 4.1/4.2 end in a bold ASCII colon
「AC or USB power button」 while the product's buttons are AC1/AC2 and DC/USB
「HP2000 Plus」 (also ts.fc.m2) is the only abbreviated product name; this edition's preface does not define an abbreviation and the rest of the manual prints 「(Jackery) HomePower 2000 Plus」

compared with the JHP-2000A-RC V2 manual, this edition has no Energy Saving Mode WARNING box, and the UPS chapter (page 15) has neither the fourth CAUTION bullet (single unit / no cascade connection) nor the WARNING box (data servers, medical devices, pacemaker); the AC AND DC OUTPUT RESUME FUNCTION table is printed on page 15 instead of page 14
source_concerns.disposition: this PDF is authoritative; nothing added from the RC edition; source owner review whether the missing safety copy is intended

transcription_cross_check: Every line is the PDF text layer, read against 150/300 dpi renders and compared with an independent Tesseract 5 OCR pass of the 300 dpi renders; remaining disagreements were OCR misreads or text inside artwork, re-read on 300 dpi clips. The JHP-2000A-RC transcription supplied the line ids only; every line was checked against this PDF, both directions (RC line missing here / text here not in a line).

en.caption_text: Alerts individuals to information that must be read to avoid potential hazards or risks.
Read the user manual before operation.
Keep the product away from fire.
This symbol indicates that a lithium-ion (Li-ion) battery is inside the product and should be disposed of or recycled properly.

This symbol indicates that the product shall not be disposed of as household waste, and should be delivered to a designated collection facility for recycling. Proper disposal and recycling can help protect the environment. For more information about the disposal and recycling of this product, contact your local community, disposal service, or dealer.
